title: Ye ghar butool ka hai
body:
Zamee'n pe arshe mo'alla dikhai deta hai..(2)
ye ghar to kaabe ko kaaba dikhai deta hai
ye ghar butool ka hai..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Namaz e madha ka unwaan hai butool ka ghar
har ek shaan mein zeeshan hai butool ka ghar
jaha'n ka markaze eemaan hai butool ka ghar
makaan e aayat e qur'aan hai butool ka ghar
ye kibriya ke liye zebo zayn ka ghar hai
makaan e zehra hasan aur husain ka ghar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kamaal ghar hai yaha'n bakamaal rehte hai
misaal kya ke yaha'n bemisaal rehte hai
khayal e rabb ke sabhi hum khayaal rehte hai
janab e zehra ke zohra jamaal rehte hai
zamee'n pe arsh e mo'alla dikhai deta hai
ye ghar to kaabe ko kaaba dikhai deta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai is makaan ka darr karbala ka darwaza
kushada darr hai ye uqda kusha ka darwaza
yehi to darr hai shahe ambiya ka darwaza
dare rasool e khuda hai khuda ka darwaza
taharato'n ki mutahhir faza mein khulta hai
faqat ye darr hai jo bayte khuda mein khulta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Isi pe arsh e sitara utar ke aaya hai
yahi'n pe dee'n ka sahara utar ke aaya hai
kalaam e haq yahi'n saara utar ke aaya hai
yaha'n khuda ka utara utar ke aaya hai
falak ke waasi utar kar zamee'n par aate hai
farishte rotiya'n lene yahi'n par aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Har ek khaak ka zarra nagee'n hai is ghar mein
falak se aala hai jitni zamee'n hai is ghar mein
har ek arsh nashee'n hum nashee'n hai is ghar mein
maka'n jo rakhta nahi wo makee'n hai is ghar mein
makaan aisa kaha'n hadde do jahaaan mein hai
nuseriyo'n ka khuda bhi isi makaan mein hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ye darr hayaat ka darr hai sifaat ka darr hai
makaan e zehra ka darr kayenat ka darr hai
ye darr dar asl had e mumkinaat ka darr hai
yehi to darr hai jo sabki nijaat ka darr hai
qadam yaha'n malakul maut ke ukhadte hai
isi pe ruk ke Mohammad(s.a.w.w.) durood padte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bani hai aayat e qur'aa se iski deewarein
hai muntasil hade yazdaa'n se iski deewarein
baland aalam e imkaa'n se iski deewarein
mili hai rabb ke shabistaa'n se iski deewarein
bina makaan ki allah ke karam par hai
jaha'n se manzile kausain do qadam par hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Balandiyo ki alamat hai is makaan ki chhat
hai past saamne is chhat ke aasmaan ki chhat
bayaan kaise ho ye wus'at e bayaan ki chhat
makaan e zehra ki ye chhat hai do jahaan ki chhat
isi ki chhao hai azmat ke aasmano par
ye chhat hai saaya figan paanch(5) saayebano par
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Isi makaan mein allah ka habeeb bhi hai
isi makaa'n mein makee'n amn ka naqeeb bhi hai
qareeb e kaaba hai allah se qareeb bhi hai
isi makaan mein fitrus tera tabeeb bhi hai
tawaaf iska ye kul kayenaat karti hai
yaha'n kaneez bhi aayat mein baatein karti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
10. Isi makaan ke darbaan meesam o salmaa'n
yahi'n pe noor ali deen e haqq hua hai jawa'n
yahi'n pe adna sa khidmat guzaar hai rizwaa'n
yahi'n kharidi hai haider ne marziye yazdaa'n
yahi'n pe dhalti hai shab din yahi nikalta hai
yaha'n pe chalti hai chakki to waqt chalta hai
ye ghar butool ka hai..(4)
